home.heroKicker: Fabric house — a real gallery in Zagazig
home.heroTitle: Every grade on the table, every bolt under real light
home.heroSubtitle: Al Azhar Tex: a full-category fabric gallery in Ziraa, past the Abu Hammad car station. See the difference between grades A, B and C before you choose — and handle the bolt yourself under gallery light.
home.galleryBandTitle: The gallery, opposite Abu Hammad station
home.galleryBandBody: Nothing stands between you and the gallery. The address is plain and the door is open every day: walk in, handle the fabric, and see grade A next to B and C for yourself.
home.gradesTitle: Three grades — written on every bolt
home.gradesBody: Grade A is first quality for export, grade B is sound and price-led, grade C is overstock clearance. We hide no defects and sugarcoat none.
home.categoriesBody: Women's apparel fabrics as the core line, with shirting, knits, lace and tulle, home textiles, linings and surplus.
home.twinBody: Tune the fabric on screen before you order: drape, stretch and weight sliders, with the result updating live.
home.provenanceBody: Every lot carries an open record: origin, chain and source — generated deterministically and verifiable anytime.
home.founderBody: We started from a small gallery and the stock we are proud of. Our policy is simple: write the grade on the bolt, put it under the light, and let you see it before you pay. Grade A for export or clearance C in bulk — we are here.
home.contactBody: One step is enough: ask on WhatsApp with a fabric code and grade, call, or come to the gallery opposite Abu Hammad station.
home.footerAbout: A fabric house and gallery in Zagazig, Sharkia. Every grade is written down and open to view.

grades.statement: Sellers who hide the grade are not hurting the fabric — they are hurting trust. We write the grade on every bolt, put it under the light, and let you see it yourself. Grade C is no shame: it is clearance in bulk at a price that earns its place, and buyers who know what they are doing choose it on purpose.

wholesale.benefit1Body: We sell grades A, B and C in the same order — you choose the grade each line needs, with the price that goes with it.

wholesale.benefit3Body: Domestic supply first, export enquiries second — talk to us for details.

about.title: About Al Azhar Tex
about.subtitle: A family fabric house in Zagazig, with a real gallery that keeps its door open to every buyer.
about.body1: Al Azhar Tex is a family fabric house in Zagazig, Sharkia governorate. The gallery sits in the Ziraa district past the Abu Hammad car station — a location every local knows: directly opposite the station.
about.body2: Our stock covers every category, with women's apparel fabrics as the core line: chiffon, crepe, satin, viscose, cotton voile, jersey, single knit, lace, tulle, organza, brocade, linen blends, linings and more. Every line is stocked in three quality grades: A, B and C.
about.body3: Our philosophy is plain: write the grade on the bolt, put it under the light, and let you see and decide for yourself. Nothing is hidden from the buyer.
about.founderBody: Shady Anwar runs the gallery and the stock from the start. For any fabric or grade question, reach him directly on WhatsApp — the answer is personal and quick.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.body: Al Azhar Tex is a static site. We store no personal data on servers — trade registration and settings live on your device only (localStorage and sessionStorage). Publishing content happens through GitHub using your own token. There are no trackers or tracking cookies.
legal.terms.title: Terms and conditions
legal.terms.body: Prices are per metre and vary by grade and quantity. Grades A, B and C are described openly on the grades pages, and every purchase relies on inspection at the gallery. Supply is per agreement, payment per the terms of each order.
